meta.title: Pepperjam
meta.description: Pepperjam — cozy countryside illustrations, stickers and prints.

site.tagline: cozy little drawings from the countryside

bio: I draw cozy critters, tiny gardens and snacks that look a little too happy to be eaten. Most of my work starts as a doodle in a sketchbook just like this one.
When I'm not drawing I'm usually tending tomatoes, making jam, or playing farming games until 2am. Take a look around, and feel free to say hi!

notes.right: click any doodle to take a closer look!
